description: Climate Resilience Evaluation and Awareness Tool (CREAT) Streamflow Projections Map is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by EPA Creating Resilient Water Utilities Program. This tool provides projections of possible changes in flow conditions for U.S. streams and rivers under a range of potential future environmental conditions. Any changes in streamflow would present challenges to water, wastewater, and storm water utilities and the communities they serve. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Drought, Flooding – General, Water Quality. Assets: Water Infrastructure – General. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
